policy: supervised>=a OR (novelty>=b AND supervised>=c). Fixed b/c grid and every distinct a with ties; disabled supervision included, disabled novelty once. Optimize TP then fewer FP subject to all four targets.
rationale: Ungated novelty alarms include too many normal rows; test learned supervised support for novelty rather than hand-written amount or subtype rules.
evaluation_limit: Designed after inspecting prior development errors and selected on the same development data. Not independent validation; cannot support promotion. A frozen future validation remains required.
